name: Baingan Bharta
ingredients: 2 garlic cloves, 1 green chilli and 1 tsp ginger, minced
½ tsp coriander powder and ¼ tsp turmeric
½ cup cooked chickpeas, lightly mashed
steps: Rub the eggplant with a little oil, prick with a fork, and roast directly over a flame (or at 220°C in the oven for 40 minutes) until the skin is charred and the flesh collapses.
Cool, peel off the skin, and mash the flesh.
Heat the oil, crackle the cumin, then cook onion, ginger, garlic and chilli for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and spices and cook for 6 minutes. Add the peas and ¼ cup water; cook 4 minutes.
Fold in the mashed chickpeas together with the eggplant.
Fold in the mashed eggplant, cook for 5 minutes and finish with coriander.
note: Flame-roasting gives the characteristic smoky flavour with very little oil.
